description: What one person said in the interviews Real Alpha cut, newest first: every moment where they are talking, or only those on a topic, best match first. Also says who they are and links their page on Real Alpha, which lists all of it. Use it when someone asks about one named person's views. It only knows people Real Alpha has cut a moment with, and asks for the full name when a name could be more than one person.

limit.description: How many moments to return, 10 if not given, 20 at most

person.description: Their name: "Jensen Huang", "Demis Hassabis", or a surname when only one person has it
